speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a pruritic rash on both of your upper extremities; tell me, how long have you been experiencing this, and has the itching worsened with sweating or heat?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient complains of a pruritic rash on both upper extremities that has been present for 5 months. She notes that the rash occasionally worsens but has not completely resolved at any point. She denies any recent illnesses and mentions that she has not started any new medications or come into contact with any new substances that she is aware of.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies.

The chronicity of your rash over 5 months, combined with the bilateral distribution on your upper extremities, is highly suggestive of scabies, even without a reported recent exposure to a sick contact. Has anyone in your household or close circle been experiencing similar skin issues or intense itching?
